index-shelf.notes: Stepped shelf, three folio stacks and open base remain distinct at 160x112, 80x56 and 64x45. Cream paper and green stone are separated. Larger foreground shelf reads well; no replacement for tactical tiles.

reading-lectern.notes: Sloping blank folio leads; curved bracket and broad foot visibly support it. Clear silhouette at all reviewed sizes, with a useful open pocket under the stem.

scroll-cradle.notes: Unequal scroll ends, hanging sheet and crescent stone support stay readable at compact size. Sparse spiral cuts remain subordinate; paper does not become a weapon or relic.

floodgate-wheel.notes: Large open wheel against short masonry is distinct at compact size. Copper axle and attached support read; spokes become thin at 64x45, so keep as composition prop rather than tactical icon.

broken-stair.notes: Broad risers, broken side face and one moss seam read at all reviewed sizes. Quiet plane construction; useful separable elevation prop.

hinged-screen.notes: Unequal connected panels form an open V; hinge remains visible at native size. Compact reads as paired screens/windows rather than a doorway. Concept usage should preserve that reading.

inkstone-basin.notes: Clear oblong lip, dark reflective pool and fitted low plinth. Pool is nearly opaque, consistent with ink; do not reuse this as transparent water or glass.

survey-table.notes: Broad diagonal blank map and continuous heavy supports read clearly. Fine channel/weight details simplify at compact size, but map-table identity survives.
